description: First contact with Mom. The player can discover Bjarne’s name and 40th birthday through a subtle question or a blunt memory lapse.

choices.text: I've been busy, but I'm doing okay. How about you?
I know, I haven't been very good at keeping in touch.
Have I been away for a while?
Can you remind me what my name is?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I'm doing alright, honey. Just been keeping myself busy.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I was starting to wonder when I'd hear from you again.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You always have some project or deadline keeping you occupied. Just make sure you're taking care of yourself, alright?

choices.text: Did something happen recently? I feel like I've forgotten something important.
When is my birthday again?
I'm sure I'll remember. Let's talk later.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart, you don't need to apologize. I know you have a lot going on.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I just like hearing from you every now and then.

choices.text: Did something happen recently? I feel like I've forgotten something important.
When is my birthday again?
I'll try to call more often.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Well, we haven't had a proper conversation in a little while.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I know you're independent, but that doesn't mean you have to disappear completely!

choices.text: Did something happen recently? I feel like I've forgotten something important.
Was there something you wanted to talk to me about?
I didn't mean to worry you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: ...What? Bjarne, honey. Your name is Bjarne.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: It's Mom. Are you feeling alright? Did something happen?

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: Bjarne. A familiar designation, at least. We should be careful not to alarm her.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: Well, that's one variable solved. Name: Bjarne. Moving on.

choices.text: Sorry, I was just joking.
Actually... what happened this weekend?
I don't remember much right now.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Oh... Well, you certainly had me worried for a moment.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You know you can always talk to me, right?

choices.text: I appreciate that. Did something happen recently?
I'll be alright. Talk soon?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart. That doesn't sound like you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Have you been sleeping? Are you feeling unwell?

choices.text: I'm sorry. I think I'm just overwhelmed.
I don't want you to worry. I'll call again soon.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Well, your birthday, for one!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I called you on Saturday, remember? I wanted to wish you a happy birthday.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I know you don't like making a big fuss about it, Bjarne, but turning another year older is still worth celebrating!

choices.text: Oh, right. Thank you, Mom. I'm sorry I missed your call.
My birthday? I must have had a lot on my mind.
Wait, when is my birthday?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Bjarne! It's on Saturday. You turned forty this year, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You're worrying me a little. Are you sure everything is alright?

choices.text: Forty... I really must have had a lot on my mind.
I'm sorry I missed your call. I should have called you back.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Of course, sweetheart. I was hoping we could have a proper chat, but I understand.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Maybe we can make up for it sometime soon?

choices.text: I'd like that. I'll make time.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Is everything alright? You sound a little distracted.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You haven't been sleeping properly, have you?

choices.text: I think I just need to slow down a little.
I'll be okay, Mom. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Take care of yourself, honey. And remember that I'm always here.
